info.title: RBAC role families demo API
info.description: A booking API whose data scope depends on the caller's role family. Every read goes through one scope rule, so lists and by-id lookups agree. Out-of-scope resources return 404; missing permissions return 403; missing or revoked tokens return 401.

get.summary: Shows how the caller is seen: principal kind, role, family and live effective permissions.

parameters.name: X-On-Behalf-Of
parameters.description: Act as another user. Needs users.act-on-behalf, a target the caller outranks inside their tenant (and account), and applies the target's scope and permissions. Refused with 403 or 404, never ignored.

get.summary: Role by action matrix computed from the caller's tenant's stored role defaults, the strategy registries and the endpoint permissions.
get.description: The same model as docs/access-matrix.md, which is generated from the code-defined catalog. This response uses the caller's tenant's stored role defaults, so it follows edits made through the administration API. Per-user grants and revokes are not reflected.

put.summary: Replaces a role's default permissions in the caller's tenant (system administrators only).
put.description: The caller must hold every permission they add or remove, and reserved permissions cannot be touched. Role defaults belong to a tenant, so the change applies to the caller's tenant only and revokes the sessions of that tenant's holders of the role.

put.description: The caller can only touch permissions they hold effectively and only users inside their management scope. A change revokes the user's sessions and is audited.
